# Boli - Open AI for Nepal

> Boli runs open AI models for Nepal: chat in English, Romanized Nepali or both, and an OpenAI-compatible API with 100 free credits.

This file is the published text of bolihq.com in one place. The short index is /llms.txt.

## Facts

- Model: boli-chat (Gemma 4 E4B, 4-bit; google/gemma-4-E4B-it (Apache 2.0), quantized by ggml-org). Licence: Apache 2.0. Context: 8192 tokens.
- Languages: English, Romanized Nepali, Nepali (Devanagari), Code-mixed.
- Price per 1M tokens: Rs 2 input, Rs 6 output. 1 credit = Rs 1 (NPR).
- 100 free credits when the email is verified. Credit packs: Rs 100 -> 100 credits, Rs 500 -> 500 credits, Rs 1000 -> 1050 credits, Rs 5000 -> 5500 credits.
- Rate limit: 30 requests per minute per account.
- API: OpenAI-compatible, base URL https://app.bolihq.com/v1, POST /v1/chat/completions. Boli runs only open models.

## Docs

- Quickstart: https://bolihq.com/docs/quickstart
- Authentication and errors: https://bolihq.com/docs/authentication
- Chat completions: https://bolihq.com/docs/chatcompletions
- Models, pricing and limits: https://bolihq.com/docs/models
- Model page: https://bolihq.com/models/boli-chat
